parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The key of the business space. If you do not specify this parameter, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The time is in the yyyyMMdd format, such as 20190401.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of data entries. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: RobotInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the chatbot instance.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The time is in the yyyyMMdd format, such as 20190401.
